description: This file defines the LoggerFactory class within the OrangeHRM framework. It provides a static method to obtain and cache logger instances, configuring them with appropriate handlers based on runtime environment settings.

classes.name: LoggerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing logger instances within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a singleton logger instance with a specified name and optional path, configuring its logging level based on the application's debug mode.
